sentences.text:
Main Case No.W.P.No.31387 of 2023
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
 Date Order
No. NOTE 02. 15.12.2023 UDPR,J & KM,J  Today the girl namely, Rangidi Sai Sriya and her  parents i.e., the 6th respondent and his wife are present in the Court.
We have enquired them in our Judges Chamber individually with reference to the petition averments and counter averments of the 6th respondent.
Admittedly, Rangidi Sai Sriya is a major.
When enquired she stated that she was brought from her maternal grandmother's house today.
She expressed her unwillingness to go to the residence of her parents.

It is also seen that in the counter of the 6th respondent, so many allegations are made against the petitioner and materials sought to be produced to show that some criminal cases are pending against him and he is in Sub-Jail, Kavali in connection with Cr.No.96 of 2023 U/s 417, 420, 376, 506 r/w 34 IPC, Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) SC & ST POA Act, 2015 of Kavali II Town PS.
It is informed to us that the said case was registered against him on a complaint given by another lady.

In view of the above fact situation, we consider it apposite to direct the 4th respondent to file his counter with reference to the petition averments as well as the counter averments filed by the 6th respondent and to hear the matter on merits.

In the meanwhile, having regard fact situation we also consider apposite to direct the 4 th respondent to admit the girl Rangidi Sai Sriya in NTR CSD & EW, Mahila Pranganam, Near Collector Banglow, Guntur until further orders.
During her stay in NTR CSD & EW, Mahila Pranganam, Near Collector Banglow, Guntur neither her parents nor the petitioner or his relatives shall make an attempt to meet her.
